title: Self-adaptive asynchronous federal learning method with local privacy protection

pse.problem: The invention addresses three disadvantages in existing federal learning methods: overlook of asynchronous learning, lack of consideration for central server untrustworthiness, and lack of adaptive gradient clipping criteria for local privacy protection.
pse.solution_function: The self-adaptive asynchronous federal learning method with local privacy protection performs the following functions: initializes a global model by the central server, broadcasts global model parameters, gradient clipping standards, a noise mechanism, and noise variances to all participating users; trains the global model locally using user samples, applies adaptive gradient clipping, and disturbs gradients with noise; sends disturbed gradients back to the central server.
pse.solution_structure: Key components include: central server, participating users, a global model, local data, gradient clipping standards, a noise mechanism, and noise variances.
pse.solution_implementation: The process includes: initialization of global model by the central server; broadcasting of global model parameters, gradient clipping standards, a noise mechanism, and noise variances to all participating users; local training by each user using samples from their data; adaptive gradient clipping at the user level; addition of noise to disturbed gradients; sending disturbed gradients back to the central server.
pse.effect: The method ensures user privacy through local encryption and noise addition, improves learning efficiency with asynchronous learning, and provides a final model utility comparable to centralized mode due to adaptive gradient clipping.
